finding.summary: When _BACKEND == "qtorch": Module-level env var read at import time selects the posit/float quantizer implementation. posit_quantize (line 157-159) and float_quantize (line 170-172) then delegate to qtorch_plus instead of the pure-PyTorch `_posit_quantize_torch`/`_float_quantize_torch` used by core.search_channels, so the whole FlexPosit numerical core runs a different implementation depending ...

paper.quote: Set ``FLEXPOSIT_BACKEND=qtorch`` to route both functions to qtorch_plus.
